findings.design: Readiness card shows a week-over-week trend, e.g. '↑3% this week' (a delta on the same metric).
findings.app: Readiness card's sub-label is `trajectoryLabel`, an entirely different metric: 'exam-ready in ~N weeks' (a projected time-to-ready estimate), shown only when a trajectory exists.
findings.evidence: design: openspec/design/CertDetail.html:140 (sub: '↑3% this week'); app: apps/web/app/components/OverviewTab.vue:73-79 + apps/web/app/composables/certStatRow.ts:34-36 (trajectoryLabel = `exam-ready in ~${weeksToReady} weeks`)

findings.design: Every recent-session row shows a green delta pill (e.g. '+3%', '+2%', '+8%') next to the accuracy percentage.
findings.app: RecentSessionsPanel only renders a DeltaBadge for index 0, gated on a `readinessDelta` prop — but OverviewTab never passes that prop when instantiating the panel, so `deltaFor` always resolves to null and no delta badge is ever rendered for any row.
findings.evidence: design: openspec/design/CertDetail.html:196-213 (delta on every row); app: apps/web/app/components/OverviewTab.vue:137 (`<RecentSessionsPanel :sessions="sessions" />`, no readiness-delta binding) vs apps/web/app/components/RecentSessionsPanel.vue:7,15-16,39

findings.element: Right-column layout (Suggested next + Recent sessions stacked)
findings.design: A fixed 260px right column stacks 'Suggested next' above 'Recent sessions', beside the wider Domain scores column.
findings.app: Grid is only 2 columns (`md:grid-cols-[2fr_1fr]`) holding Domain Breakdown and Suggested-next; RecentSessionsPanel is placed as a separate full-width block below that grid, not stacked in the right column.
findings.evidence: design: openspec/design/CertDetail.html:153,183-219 (width:260 column contains both blocks); app: apps/web/app/components/OverviewTab.vue:95-137 (grid ends at line 135, RecentSessionsPanel at line 137 is a sibling below, full width)

findings.design: Each of the 4 stats (Readiness, Sessions, Questions, Avg accuracy) is its own bordered/rounded card (`border: 1px solid`, `borderRadius: rXl`, own background) sitting in a gapped row.
findings.app: All 4 stats share a single undifferentiated container (`bg-black/25 p-4` grid) with no per-card border or background — the individual card affordance is lost.
findings.evidence: design: openspec/design/CertDetail.html:138-151; app: apps/web/app/components/OverviewTab.vue:66-93 (single `data-testid="cert-detail-stat-row"` div, no per-card border)

findings.design: Each stat card has a small caption under the value: Sessions → 'completed', Questions → 'answered', Avg accuracy → 'per session'.
findings.app: ProgressStatCard only renders label + value (+ optional unit); no sub-caption slot is used for Sessions, Questions, or Avg accuracy in OverviewTab.
findings.evidence: design: openspec/design/CertDetail.html:141-148 (`sub` field per stat); app: apps/web/app/components/ProgressStatCard.vue:11-19 (no sub-caption row) and apps/web/app/components/OverviewTab.vue:81-92 (no sub text passed)

findings.design: Below the Recent sessions card, a right-aligned 'View all sessions →' link is shown, linking presumably to the Sessions tab.
findings.app: No such link/affordance exists in RecentSessionsPanel or OverviewTab; the only way to reach the Sessions tab is the top-level tab bar.
findings.evidence: design: openspec/design/CertDetail.html:215-217; app: apps/web/app/components/RecentSessionsPanel.vue:19-45 (ends with the card, no link)

findings.design: Row shows only date, duration (+ ' · Mock' suffix when applicable), accuracy% (color-coded by score band), and delta.
findings.app: Row shows date, duration, then a combined 'Kind · focus-area/domains' label (e.g. 'Study · IAM, Networking') in place of design's simple duration/mock-tag line, and accuracy is plain uncolored text (no score-band coloring).
findings.evidence: design: openspec/design/CertDetail.html:196-213; app: apps/web/app/components/RecentSessionsPanel.vue:29-38 + apps/web/app/composables/recentSessionLabel.ts:24-25 (`${kind} · ${focusArea}`), no color class on accuracy span

findings.design: Both Domain scores and Recent sessions cards have a 1px divider between each row (`i < len-1 && <div border/>`).
findings.app: DomainScoreBar rows use `mb-2` spacing only, and RecentSessionsPanel rows use `mb-2`/`last:mb-0` spacing — no divider element between rows in either list.
findings.evidence: design: openspec/design/CertDetail.html:176,211; app: apps/web/app/components/OverviewTab.vue:97-102 (mb-2, no divider) and apps/web/app/components/RecentSessionsPanel.vue:26 (mb-2, no divider)

findings.design: No such link exists between the header and the tab bar; the design's header/tabs are adjacent with no intervening row.
findings.app: An extra right-aligned 'View progress' NuxtLink row is inserted between CertHeaderBar and the tab bar, not present in the design.
findings.evidence: design: openspec/design/CertDetail.html:98-119,89-95 (CertHeader directly followed by CertTabs); app: apps/web/app/pages/user-certifications/[id]/index.vue:76-84 (extra `view-progress-link` block before the tablist)
